<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=EB+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=DM+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap');

  /* === Container (cream card on neutral page) === */
  .gloss-hub__container {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    background: #F7F5F0;
    color: #1A1A18;
    max-width: 880px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 72px 40px 80px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
  }

  /* === Hero block === */
  .gloss-hub__eyebrow {
    font-family: 'DM Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #888880;
    margin: 0 0 16px 0;
  }
  .gloss-hub__name {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    font-size: 3.2rem;
    line-height: 1.08;
    font-weight: 400;
    color: #1A1A18;
    letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    margin: 0 0 20px 0;
  }
  .gloss-hub__intro {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    font-size: 1.15rem;
    line-height: 1.6;
    color: #2A2A26;
    margin: 0 0 56px 0;
    max-width: 640px;
  }
  .gloss-hub__intro a {
    color: #1A1A18;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 3px;
    text-decoration-thickness: 0.5px;
  }

  /* === Category section === */
  .gloss-hub__category {
    margin-bottom: 56px;
  }
  .gloss-hub__category-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 16px;
    font-family: 'DM Mono', 'Courier New', monospace;
    font-size: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #888880;
    margin: 0 0 28px 0;
  }
  .gloss-hub__category-label::after {
    content: "";
    flex: 1;
    height: 0.5px;
    background-color: #C8C4BA;
  }

  /* === Term grid === */
  .gloss-hub__grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 32px 40px;
  }
  .gloss-hub__item {
    display: block;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #1A1A18;
  }
  .gloss-hub__item-name {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    font-size: 1.2rem;
    line-height: 1.3;
    color: #1A1A18;
    font-weight: 500;
    margin: 0 0 8px 0;
    text-decoration: underline;
    text-underline-offset: 4px;
    text-decoration-thickness: 0.5px;
    text-decoration-color: #C8C4BA;
  }
  .gloss-hub__item:hover .gloss-hub__item-name {
    text-decoration-color: #888880;
    color: #1A1A18;
  }
  .gloss-hub__item-summary {
    font-family: 'EB Garamond', Georgia, serif;
    font-size: 0.92rem;
    line-height: 1.55;
    color: #555550;
    margin: 0;
  }

  /* === Mobile === */
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .gloss-hub__container {
      padding: 48px 24px 64px;
    }
    .gloss-hub__name {
      font-size: 2.4rem;
    }
    .gloss-hub__intro {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }
    .gloss-hub__grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .gloss-hub__item-name {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
    }
  }
</style>
